dct_description_sm: The study seeks to evaluate the following reseach questions:  A) On which seedbeds do planted black spruce seedlings survive and establish with the highest success?  B) Are bear digs an equitable microhabitat for black spruce seedlings?  C) Do seed and seedling predation occur more frequently on a particular seedbed?  What is the magnitude of this potential difference?  D) On which seedbed do black spruce seeds emerge and establish with the highest success?  E) What is the relative importance of predation and seedbed factors in black spruce survival above the treeline of the Mealy Mountains?  The study will also contribute data to predictive models of potential black spruce migration above the current treeline.
dct_title_s: Black spruce emergence and early seedling survival in the Mealy Mountains, Labrador
